text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oryo? Trainer,
are you giving this to me?
I wonder what's inside...
choice_data_list: It's mineral bath salts! A specialty of Yukoma Hot Springs!
It's mineral bath salts! A specialty of Yukoma Hot Springs!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oho~... Hot spring mineral crystals...
If I remember correctly, the way to use them is...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: You put it in the bathwater, right? Do that, and it instantly feels like a hot spring...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Giving me such a precious item...
and in such a large pack, too.
I'm so glad, truly grateful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute smiles warmly at the modest gift.
Watching her with a comforting warmth in my heart...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, souvenir shop pops!
Got a sec? I wanna ask ya somethin'!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "Got any of them 'yunohana' crystals? If ya do, sell me some. I brought plenty of pocket change."

text_block_list.name: Souvenir Shop Guy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry. I just sold out
to that customer over there.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
The hell did you saaaay?!
Wait... Acute?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Well now, if it isn't Espo-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This Umamusume is Espoir City.
She is one of the powerhouses on dirt tracks.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Tch, buying up a whole damn mountain of 'em.
Hand one over. I'll pay for it.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I mean, why did you buy up so much?
Are you opening a street stall or something?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Nah, this here's a present from Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
A present, you say?!
Dammit... it's a handout, isn't it... In that case—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Alright—let's settle this.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huh... A showdown?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, gotta settle the score fair and square!
If I win the mock race, give me one of 'em."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I'll show ya what I'm made of!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I see.
In that case, would you mind if I joined in?
Is that alright with you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, we rented out a section of the Yukoma Hot Springs resort to hold a mock race, but...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Doryaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fuho!? What incredible dash power...
She's like Idaten himself, isn't she...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "I ain't giving up the lead! When it comes to guts, I won't lose to anybody!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Keep up with me, Acute!!
Daaaahryaaaaaaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh... Just chasing after them...
feels like my shoulders are gonna pop off...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
How's that?!
*This* is how I run!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: *pant, wheeze, gasp*... *phew*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An 1800m dirt race. Given that,
this time gap was practically a crushing defeat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Espoir City.
She, too, is surely one of the Umamusume
who will carry the future of the dirt racing world.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty then, Espo-san,
how about I give you one of what I promised?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Well then, from my allowance—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Nah, you showed me a great run, so no payment needed.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Seriously!? I-I see...
Well, I did run with literally everything I had.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, I'll take it!
If you want payback, come at me anytime!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Espoir City dashed away, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hmm? But why did Espo-san want hot spring mineral crust in the first place?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I haven't really heard of her liking hot springs, though...
Now, I wonder...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A small mystery remained unsolved.
